words.def: to give part of your work or responsibility to someone else in your team.
words.book: I consider myself a natural leader, and I have experience managing teams and delegating tasks to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
uses: I've delegated the site survey to Karim so I can focus on the quotation.
can u delegate the battery replacement to the night shift? i'm swamped 😅
As a manager, I delegate routine PM visits and handle the key accounts myself.
dont: I gave my work to Ahmed to make it.
doo: I delegated the task to Ahmed.

words.ar: يقلّل من أثر حاجة وحشة / يحدّ من الضرر
words.def: to make a problem or risk less serious or less harmful.
words.book: I prioritize and focus on the most important tasks, and I look for ways to mitigate any potential negative impact.
uses: To mitigate the risk of downtime, we'll install a temporary UPS during the upgrade.
any way to mitigate the delay? customer's not happy
Regular battery testing helps us mitigate the risk of sudden failures.
dont: We will make the problem smaller.
doo: We'll take steps to mitigate the risk.

words.ar: مبادر / بيتحرك قبل ما المشكلة تحصل
words.def: acting early to prevent problems instead of waiting for them to happen.
words.book: I handle challenging situations by taking a proactive approach.
uses: We're taking a proactive approach and replacing the batteries before they reach end of life.
nice, very proactive of you to call the client first 👍
We need to be more proactive with overdue invoices, not wait 90 days.
dont: I solve the problem before it comes.
doo: I take a proactive approach to problems.

words.def: when everyone understands and agrees about the plan or situation.
words.book: I also remain flexible and open to new ideas, and I communicate effectively with my team to ensure everyone is on the same page.
uses: Just to make sure we're on the same page, the warranty covers parts but not labour.
quick call so we're all on the same page before the client meeting?
Before we send the offer, let's make sure sales and service are on the same page.
goes: get everyone on the same page
make sure we're on the same page
dont: We must all be understanding the same thing.
doo: Let's make sure we're all on the same page.

words.ar: في الوقت المناسب / من غير تأخير
words.book: I also established a regular communication schedule with the client to ensure their needs were being met and any issues were addressed in a timely manner.
uses: We kindly ask that the outstanding invoice be settled in a timely manner.
pls reply to the ticket in a timely manner, SLA is 4 hrs ⏱️
Our contract commits us to responding to service calls in a timely manner.
goes: be addressed in a timely manner
dont: We will answer you in the fast time.
doo: We will respond in a timely manner.

words.ar: يحافظ على / يخلّي العميل يفضل معانا
words.def: to keep something or someone, especially a customer or employee.
words.book: Through my efforts, I was able to retain the client and even expand our business with them.
uses: Our priority this year is to retain our key accounts and renew all maintenance contracts.
Offering a free health check helped us retain the client.
dont: I made the client stay with us.
doo: I managed to retain the client.

upgrade.plain: I am a leader by nature.
pro: I consider myself a natural leader.
I am born to be the boss.

upgrade.plain: When the customer shouted, I shouted too.
upgrade.ar: لما العميل زعق، زعقت أنا كمان
pro: I stayed calm and composed, even when the customer raised his voice.
I shouted on him because he shouted first.
upgrade.why: في المقابلة بيّن إنك ‎calm and composed‎ مش عصبي.

upgrade.plain: I want to know the real reason of the problem.
pro: I want to know the real reason of the problem.
I want to know why the problem is problem.
I try to understand the root cause of the problem.
upgrade.why: ‎root cause‎ هو المصطلح المستخدم في الشغل.

pro: I don't take it on my chest.
I avoid getting defensive or personal.
I don't take it personal never.
upgrade.why: ‎on my chest‎ ترجمة حرفية؛ قول ‎avoid getting defensive or personal‎.

upgrade.plain: I want both of us to win.
pro: I always strive for a win-win solution.
I want we are both winners.
I want the two sides to take.
upgrade.why: ‎win-win solution‎ تعبير شائع جدًا في التفاوض.

upgrade.plain: The project was late, and we returned it to the right way.
upgrade.ar: المشروع كان متأخر ورجّعناه على السكة
pro: We returned the project to the right way.
We made the project go correct again.
We were able to get the project back on track.
upgrade.why: ‎back on track‎ = رجع ماشي صح في ميعاده.
